question: Where can I get the railway network (geometry) of Spain, with line type, electrification, infrastructure manager and traffic?

answer.summary: Geometry with electrification, gauge and track count for the whole network (Adif plus FGC, Euskotren, SFM, metro, tram) is in IGN's INSPIRE WFS (60,018 links, CC BY 4.0). Line type is partial (train/metro/tram on 497 lines). Manager is only an administration level there; ERA RINF gives a manager code for 2,520 Adif sections. Traffic exists only as train-km per axis and top-10 lines (CNMC PDF). Adif's own WFS is blocked to automated clients.
main_caveats: IGN attributes are separate features linked to links; many links lack electrification (38,120) or track count (37,336) of 60,018. GML only.
ERA RINF geometry is a 2-point chord per section and only manager code 0071; the code was not confirmed as Adif by any page.
Traffic is per axis and top-10 lines only, RFIG only (no FGC, Euskotren, SFM, metro or tram).
ideadif.adif.es, www.adif.es and www.transportes.gob.es answered 403 to automated clients; Adif's own WFS and network statement were not read.
Network lengths differ: Adif 15,654.1 km (OFE 2024), RFIG 15,678 km (CNMC 2025), RINF sections sum 15,537 km.
answer.confidence_reason: Geometry, electrification and RINF were tested live; traffic and manager rely on PDFs; Adif's primary services were blocked and Catalan/Basque catalogues not fully checked.

attributes.note: IGN WFS: 60,018 polylines, all managers. RINF has only 2-point chords per section.
RailwayType train 378, metro 65, tramway 45 on 497 lines; BOE blocks; Valencia tipo_linea. No Adif service-class type.
attributes.gap_note: Adif Declaración sobre la Red (line classification for fees) lives on adif.es, which returned 403; not opened.

attributes.note: IGN boolean on 38,120 links; RINF voltage per track (3 kV DC, 25 kV AC, 1.5 kV DC); BOE by line.
RINF: one manager code (0071) for Spain; OFE names Adif, ETS, FGC, SFM; Valencia titularidad. IGN gives owner level only.
attributes.gap_note: Per-segment manager for FGC, Euskotren and SFM links not found; Catalan and Basque IDE catalogues not rendered by my tools, ICGC not opened.

attributes.note: CNMC train-km per axis (12) and top-10 lines; OFE density trains/km/day. No per-segment dataset seen.
attributes.gap_note: Line-level occupancy in Adif's Declaración sobre la Red (adif.es 403) not read; CNMC Data API not explored.

attempts: Read WFS GetCapabilities abstract (servicios.idee.es): lists the five transport modes but no exclusion rule.
Read IGN product specification IGR-RT V0.5 (2016-03-16, from ign.es zip): rail section lists properties, no explicit exclusion list.

key_fields.meaning: gml:LineString (posList lat lon, EPSG:4258); one record per track section; net:fictitious=true for yard tracks
boolean per link (38,120 records); link referenced in net:networkRef/net:LinkReference/net:element xlink:href
gauge (60,018 records, nominalGauge nil in the sample) and track count (37,336 records), same linking pattern
line type codelist: train 378, metro 65, tramway 45, funicular 6, cogRailway 3 (497 records, attached to RailwayLine features)
administration level of the owner (e.g. 'Administración General del Estado'), not the manager company; 5,261,627 records for all modes

how_to_use.example_result: hits: numberMatched="60018". Sample record: gml:id TN-RA_RAILWAYLINK_FFCC_TR30000000827, net:fictitious=true, gml:LineString posList "38.390668 -0.515177 38.390787 -0.515290 ...". Electrification record: TN-RA_RAILWAYELECTRIFICATION_ELEC_FC460000004420, tn-ra:electrified=true.
steps: Run GetCapabilities and pick the tn-ra:* feature types (RailwayLink, RailwayElectrification, NominalTrackGauge, NumberOfTracks, RailwayType, RailwayUse, RailwayLine, RailwayStationNode 3,606, RailwayNode 55,287).
Page through RailwayLink with count and startIndex (the response carries a 'next' link), or filter with bbox=lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2,urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4258.
Download the attribute feature types the same way and join them to links by the link id inside net:networkRef (TN-RA_RAILWAYLINK_FFCC_TR<id>); attribute ids end in the same number (ELEC_FC<id>).
Request GML only: outputFormat=application/json returns HTTP 400.
For the manager of the line use another source (rank 3 or 6); this service has no manager name and no traffic.
reading_traps: GML only; coordinates are lat lon (not lon lat).
Attributes are separate features that point to links, not columns: 38,120 electrification and 37,336 track-count records for 60,018 links, so many links have no value.
RailwayType and RailwayUse attach to lines/links, and in the one RailwayLine sampled name and railwayLineCode were nil (unpopulated).
featureID filtering was ignored in my test (the whole collection came back); use bbox or paging.
tn:OwnerAuthority holds 5.26 million records for all transport modes and gives administration level only.
60,018 links include fictitious yard-track links, metro and tram; filter net:fictitious and RailwayType before computing network length.

problems: National Centro de Descargas (centrodedescargas.cnig.es) returned an empty reply to curl; WebFetch showed only the menu

unit.value: lengthOfSectionOfLine in km (sum for Spain 15,537.002); WKT in lon lat degrees

attempts: ERA RINF page (era.europa.eu/domains/registers/rinf_en): describes operational points and sections of line, no inclusion rule
SPARQL: all Spanish sections carry the same manager code 0071; FGC, Euskotren, SFM not found

ERA RINF page opened: no update schedule stated
SPARQL records carry no update date
Only manager 0071 present for ESP in the graph

key_fields.meaning: line section, e.g. 'Section of Line BIF. CORESES - ZAMORA'

how_to_use.example_request:
curl -sG --data-urlencode "query@rq.txt" -H "Accept: application/sparql-results+json" https://graph.data.era.europa.eu/repositories/rinf-plus   with rq.txt =
PREFIX era: <http://data.europa.eu/949/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
SELECT ?label ?im ?len ?cls ?wkt WHERE { ?s a era:SectionOfLine ; rdfs:label ?label ; era:inCountry <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/country/ESP> ; era:infrastructureManager ?im ; era:lengthOfSectionOfLine ?len ; era:hasPart ?t ; era:netReference/geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?wkt . ?t era:contactLineSystem ?cls } LIMIT 2
how_to_use.example_result: label 'Section of Line BIF. CORESES - ZAMORA', im .../organisationRole/0071_IM, len 9.243, cls .../contactLineSystem/3ef9cb304f, wkt 'LINESTRING (-5.6318400 41.5329200, -5.7397000 41.5159000)'. Count: era:inCountry ESP gives 2520 sections.
steps: Filter sections with era:inCountry <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/country/ESP>.
Take geometry from era:netReference/geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT (2520 of 2520 have it).
Voltage: section era:hasPart ?track, ?track era:contactLineSystem ?c, ?c era:energySupplySystem ?s (skos:prefLabel).
Manager: era:infrastructureManager (one value, code 0071).
reading_traps: Every Spanish section geometry has exactly 2 points (start and end): a straight chord, not the track alignment (2,520 of 2,520).

Only one manager (0071) appears for Spain; the label gives only the code, not the company name. Its summed length (15,537 km) is close to Adif/Adif AV in CNMC (15,649-15,658 km) but I found no page confirming the code is Adif.
Track filter by era:inCountry returns nothing (country is on the section, not the track).
Regional and urban networks (FGC, Euskotren, SFM, metro) are not in the Spanish sections.
Host data-interop.era.europa.eu did not resolve from my environment; the endpoint above was taken from a search result and worked.

recipe: Take the line list and electrification from the BOE catalogue (pdftotext -layout, rejoin wrapped region cells).
Take traffic from CNMC tables 3 and 4 by the same line/axis code (tested: line 200 is 699,8 km in BOE and 700 km in CNMC).
Add manager totals from OFE (Adif, ETS, FGC, SFM) and, for Adif section-level manager and voltage, from RINF (rank 3).
Trap: CNMC covers only the RFIG; the BOE catalogue is the 2015 text with partial updates.
if_unstructured.location_method: Documents carry no coordinates. Positions come from rank 1 geometry; I did not find a populated line-code field in IGN (railwayLineCode was nil in the one RailwayLine sampled), so the link between BOE/CNMC line codes and geometry was not verified.
